description: Use this when the user needs to add credit, or to pay one specific draft letter by card. Returns a link to the payment page on printandmailcompany.com; give it to the user, who pays there. The assistant cannot pay, and calling this tool charges nothing. Needs the user's account.

letter_id.description: letter_id of a draft, e.g. ltr_8f3k2m9q4x7v1c6b0n5p: the link then pays that letter by card. Omit for a link to add prepaid credit.

name: create_topup_link
title: Create payment link
